pages.text: The $(d)Step Assist$() Gene allows players to $(9)walk up single blocks$() as if they were stairs.$(br2)This Gene $(c)cannot be given to mobs$().
These are the default chances. Modpacks may change them.$(br2)3/18 - Donkey$(br)3/16 - Horse$(br)3/8 - Llama$(br)4/16 - Polar Bear$(br)4/12 - Skeleton Horse$(br)4/12 - Zombie Horse
